page.layout: One page of text (left printed page, page 66); a narrow strip of marginal notes at the far right edge of the scan, partly cut off, belonging to the facing page's margin. Running head centred at top. No catchword visible.

main_text.p: "Απτω accendo. F.ἅψω. P.ἧφα. a.1.ἡψα. part. a.1.ἅψας ἀνθρ ὁ cum Accuf.Luc.8.16.
"Απτομαι tango. cum Genit. imperf. ἡπτόμην ϰ εἴϱ, Marc.6.56. Fut.ἅψομαι. a.1.med. ἡψά- μην ω ἀϱ tetigi, Matth.8.v.3.a.1.med.subj. ἅψωμαι ἡ ἥπτω tetigero. part.a.1.med. ἁψά- μὸς η ον.

'Απωθέομαι ἕμω repello, abjicio, Rom.13.12. ἀπωθώμεϑα (1.pl.praf.subj.med.) pro ἀπω- ϑεώμεϑα abjiciamus. F.ἀπώσομαι. a.1. med. ἀπωσάμην ω ἀϱ repuli, rejeci, Act.7.27. ex ἀπὸ ὠθέω trudo, pello. F.ὠσω. P.ὤϰα.

'Απώλεια ας ἡ exitium, 2.Thess.2.9. tanquam ab adjeϲt. ἀπώλης ε ὁ ἡ ad formam ἐξω- λης ε ὁ ἡ plane perditus, deploratus, exi- tialis, unde est ἐξώλεια ας ἡ internecio, exi- tium. a verbo ἀπόλλυμι perdo (ex ἀπὸ ὄλ- λυμι) vide suprà.
'Αρὰ ᾱς ἡ preces. item dirae, Rom.3.14. affine Hebraeo אָרָה. Hinc est ἀϱάομαι ὤμω cum Dat.precor.item imprecor mala.
"Αρα Adv. ergo, Matth.19.25. nempe,Rom.7. 25.τί ἄρα quidnam, Act.or.12.18. Luc.1.66. utique, Matth.12.v.28. ἐπεὶ ἄρα alioquin, 1.Cor.7.11.
'Αρέω ω otior. Fut.ἥσω. P.ἡρηκα. a.1. ἤρησα, 2.Pet.2.3.

page.notes: Right-hand margin notes are cut off and mostly illegible; not transcribed. Greek words are given as best read; accents uncertain in several places. Hebrew word "אָרָה" as read. The final line "Αρης" appears as a catchword-like headword at the foot right; treated as text.
